# The Lens Foundation

> The Lens Foundation is a community-focused nonprofit that turns compassion into practical support for children, families, and underserved communities through outreach, education support, food assistance, healthcare support, direct aid, and partnerships.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://thelensfoundation.org/): Overview of the foundation, current impact, events, reports, testimonials, and frequently asked questions.
- [About Us](https://thelensfoundation.org/about): Mission, vision, values, operational flow, founder message, and team.
- [Events](https://thelensfoundation.org/events): Upcoming and completed community events across Lens Foundation chapters.
- [LENS the Podium](https://thelensfoundation.org/lens-podium): Youth public-speaking and leadership programme for participants aged 11 to 19.
- [Volunteer](https://thelensfoundation.org/volunteer): Volunteer application and participation information.
- [Partner](https://thelensfoundation.org/partner): Partnership opportunities and application form.
- [Contact](https://thelensfoundation.org/contact): Contact details, enquiry form, and meeting booking.
